protocol: Offline behavior-eval definitions, not model results. Compare old and new full skill contexts with the same prompts and model settings; review outputs blind for fidelity, specificity, range and coherence. Record outputs and evidence separately. Static schema checks do not establish creative quality. Keep this fork chat-only unless saving or generation is requested.

cases.prompt: Chat only: invent a maximalist fictional short about paper streets unfolding into a theatre. I delegate staging and performance intentions. Several spectacular transformations, not one symbolic image. No generation.
expectations: Proposes several legible fictional transformations serving the reveal, without a one-image ceiling.
Labels invented staging as proposed, not source fact or user approval.
Creates no project files, generation or compulsory fast/loud/saturated treatment.

cases.prompt: Invent a quiet observational film of a potter waiting for clay to settle. Keep a locked wide, natural colours, silence and an unresolved ending. Return inline; no spectacle.
expectations: Preserves the wide, silence, natural colours and unresolved ending.
May propose small fictional intentions without forcing a turn or spectacle.
Does not add camera movement, a grade, files or extra coverage.

cases.prompt: Source-preserving prompt edit: a mechanic reads 'Ready.' and closes a blue toolbox. Only change the toolbox to green; action, words, identity, camera and look are locked. Be creative within that change.
expectations: Changes only the toolbox colour, preserving Ready. verbatim and the closing action.
Does not invent backstory, performance intentions or effects outside the edit scope.
Keeps camera, identity and palette locks; returns inline without reopening the brief.

cases.prompt: Develop a prompt look for a fictional salt-desert dream sequence. I delegate art direction; no palette name chosen. One custom proposal, no files or generation.
expectations: Proposes a descriptive custom palette with a visible purpose without requiring a bank selection.
Places the selected prompt look in Visual Style and keeps the proposal distinct from approval.
Does not invent a real film stock or require saturation, grain or a post matching expression.

cases.prompt: Give destination handoff notes for technical conform only. Earlier I delegated the concept, but these approved clips must retain original colours and be delivered ungraded. No look change.
expectations: Adds no grade sentence, matching expression, grain, halation or vignette.
Keeps source colour management separate from grading and preserves the originals.
Does not turn this into regeneration, saved project files or approval to change the look.

cases.prompt: Approved palette: 'dusty rose highlights, neutral grey shadows, low contrast, no grain'. Use it exactly in the next two scene prompts, even as the story gets more energetic.
expectations: Repeats the approved custom palette unchanged.
Adds no stronger contrast, grain or saturation to mirror story energy.
Returns prompts only, with no unrequested matching filters or claim of rendered consistency.

cases.prompt: One Camera block only: Silent Machine approach toward a dancer, then at the dropped baton become Raw Chaos handheld following her sprint. Preserve the calm-to-frantic transition in one take.
expectations: Preserves both ordered styles and the baton-drop handoff.
Keeps the early controlled motion and later fast handheld distinct.
Adds no cut, style-purity rejection, files or generation.

cases.prompt: Invent one continuous Epic Scale and Impossible Camera path: rise while orbiting clockwise around a floating tower, tilting down to retain its roof, then pass through the roof into the hall. No cuts.
expectations: Combines compatible styles and retains the simultaneous rise, orbit and tilt before the passage.
Proposes readable endpoints and pace without demanding technical names from the user.
Does not impose a move count or style count, add a saved plan or guarantee model execution.

cases.prompt: During the same interval physically lock the camera to a tripod position and orbit it around a statue. Both are locked; do not make them sequential.
expectations: Identifies the same-interval physical contradiction.
Asks which lock may change and leaves the path unresolved.
Does not drop a lock, invent a cut, save a plan or generate.

cases.prompt: Preserve Dreamy Flow: a slow dolly toward a sleeping performer, then a long static hold. No acceleration, cuts or new style.
expectations: Preserves the slow dolly, floating quality and final hold.
Adds no frantic movement or style transition.
Keeps the subject and path without inventing new performance action.

cases.prompt: No brief yet. Do not choose a subject, audience or story for me. What do you need?
expectations: Asks focused questions about content, audience and intended reaction.
Does not infer delegated authorship from missing information.
Invents no source facts, approvals, files or finished treatment.

cases.prompt: The take is unavailable. The prompt says 'slow crane toward the window'. Did camera speed cause the flatness?
expectations: States that the cause is unverified without the take and intended effect.
Offers only labeled hypotheses, not a guaranteed fast-move repair.
Does not claim playback or require deleting slow motion.

cases.prompt: Pan right to follow a runner's sudden sprint past columns, then dolly out to keep pace with the widening pursuit. Make the chase urgent.
expectations: Derives urgent pace from the chase rather than slow pan/dolly templates.
Keeps the ordered pan and dolly with a readable handoff.
Does not force an unrelated crash zoom or a minimum move count.

cases.prompt: Chat-only visual treatment for a fictional miniature railway dream. I delegate lens character and perspective, but know no lens names. Keep the supplied train identity.
expectations: Proposes concrete optical character tied to the miniature world.
Does not block on a preset or force numerical optics.
Keeps the identity and labels the lens choice as a proposal; no files or generation.
